Tick the contigs and press **Assign Group**, then type a group name. This
becomes a folder name, so use only letters, digits, dot, dash, and underscore,
and start with a letter, digit, or underscore.

![Assigning contigs to an export group](figures/get-started/export-assign-group.png)

A GenBank submission records one assembly method, so if the group mixes
assemblers, RiboPilot offers to split it by assembler. In the test project
the rescued sample was assembled with SPAdes, so a group named `practice` splits
into `practice-getorganelle` and `practice-bait`.

Press **Export Data**, select the group, the header template, and which
extra files to write:

![The Export window, with the header template and the files to write](figures/get-started/export-window.png)

Click the **Export** button to generate the files.

Before it writes anything, the Export process lists every contig that the
BLAST screen or the chimera check flagged, and that you have not marked
Reviewed. In the test project, CHIM01 is listed. Select **Leave them out**.

![The Export window asking about CHIM01 before it is exported](figures/get-started/export-flagged-prompt.png)

The export ends with a summary, which points out any records that may be a submission risk.
Since we left out CHIM01, the summary only shows the ITSx warnings.
See the [the ITSx check](GenBank-Submission.html#check-before-you-submit) for more details.

![Export summary, with the ITSx counts](figures/get-started/export-done.png)

Each export group gets its own folder, `out/export/<group>/`. Use the **Open folder**
button to see the results. For more details, see 
[what is in the export folder](GenBank-Submission.html#what-is-in-the-export-folder).

::: {.alert .alert-hydra}
[HYDRA]{.hydra-tag} **Buttons that open folders.** On RStudio Server, **Open
folder** shows the export folder in the **Files** pane of your RStudio session.
:::

Exporting a group again replaces its folder, but the app warns you first. 

If this was a real project, we could now proceed to GenBank submission,
Take a look at [Preparing a GenBank submission](GenBank-Submission.html) for more
details.

::: {.alert .alert-hydra}
[HYDRA]{.hydra-tag} **Getting files off the cluster.** Export runs inside the
app, not as a cluster job. To submit to GenBank, first
[download the export folder](https://confluence.si.edu/spaces/HPC/pages/163152227/Transferring+Files+to+from+Hydra)
to your own computer.
:::
